option.counterfactual: Every faithful normalized 2-quasitrace on a finite AW*-factor is strictly order preserving on positive elements.
option.approach: Investigate whether strict order preservation admits a uniform quantitative form on positive contractions. Such an estimate could force the quasitraces of successive increments to tend to zero.

options.counterfactual: A faithful normalized 2-quasitrace on a finite AW*-factor need not be strictly order preserving: there may be positive elements x≤y with x≠y and τ(x)=τ(y).
options.approach: Audit strict order preservation independently, distinguishing positivity of τ(y−x) from positivity of τ(y)−τ(x). If the distinction cannot be bridged, withdraw the uniform-strictness proof and retain only the justified upper bound and downward closure.

options.approach: Audit the quotient construction step by step: the null ideal, descent of the quasitrace, its additivity on abelian subalgebras, the matrix extension, projection completeness, and factoriality. Identify exactly which property fails before invoking strict order preservation in the quotient.
